card.name: Word just before a qualifying phrase
card.fires_on: The word "treated" in "being treated with MAOIs" in contraindication text. Also weaker on words like "some", "without" and "for" that open a qualifying clause.

modes.label: Being treated with MAOIs
modes.description: "treated" after "patient being" in warnings about not starting a drug in someone on MAOIs.
modes.example: do not initiate Citalopram Oral Solution in a patient being<< treated>> with MAOIs such as linez

modes.label: Words opening a qualifier
modes.description: A word such as "without" or "some" that leads into a limiting phrase or a contrast.
modes.example: They want to know why<< some>> diabetic patients do not develop complications.

modes.label: Without evidence of toxicity
modes.description: "without" after a duration of chronic use, before "evidence of muscle toxicity".
modes.example: chronically (e.g., for 12 months or more)<< without>> evidence of muscle toxicity [see WARNINGS
